Cover title. Manuscript; watercolor and ink. Labels pasted on to show distance and completed repairs on the canal. Relief shown pictorially. Shows the repaired water control system on the Grand Canal in Shangdong Province. Hummel gift 1962, no. 13b. Includes notes. Scale not given. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2: 650/1; 650/2 Filed in the same box with Hummel gift 1962, no. 13a, G7822.G7N22 1876 .Y8 Vault Shelf.
